_comment: chassis-delegation per-repo config. Every key is optional. Precedence: built-in defaults < this file < the mod options (/delegation config <field> <value>; maps merge per key). Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored.
_gateMap: Brief gate= id -> the command the verifier re-runs in the worker's own worktree, by argv (no shell). {files} is the changed-files list (one path a line); chain with ' && '. Example: {"test": "npm test", "lint": "npx eslint --max-warnings 0 {files}"}. An id the map lacks is reported 'gate not re-run' (unverified), never run raw. The key _empty names a gate id of this map (not a command): a hand-back that changes no file runs that gate instead of the card's, e.g. {"test": "npm test", "smoke": "npm run lint", "_empty": "smoke"}.
_agentTypes: Card domain -> the subagent type of the Agent call /dispatch prepares for the brain to make (the Agent tool subagent_type). A domain not named here runs on a subagent type of its own name when the session offers one, else general-purpose. Example: {"ops": "general-purpose", "web": "frontend"}.
_tierMap: Card tier -> model alias (haiku, sonnet, opus; fable is rewritten to opus). Always an alias, so model releases move the ladder.
_domains: The card domains /dispatch accepts; the branch is agent/<domain>/<id>.
_maxWorkers: Briefed workers at once; past it /dispatch says queued, and the hand-back that frees a slot says ready: <id>, and the brain makes the spawn.
_maxWorkersByTier: A lower limit on the briefed workers of one tier (economy, standard, frontier, premium), under maxWorkers; a tier not named takes maxWorkers alone. Example: {"frontier": 2}.
_maxFrontierShare: Warn when more than this share of open cards is frontier (0 to 1). Ben, 2026-11-14.
_worktreeRoot: Folder for the workers' worktrees; empty = sibling folders <repo>-<id>.
_cardDir: The folder the task cards live in, relative to the repo root. In a repo that is itself a plugin keep it out of agents/: the engine reads agents/*.md as subagents.
_briefTemplate: A brief body template file (absolute path); empty = the mod's hooks/templates/brief.md.
_briefExtra: Repo-specific lines added to every brief (setup steps, conventions, things never to do).
_briefLocal: A gitignored rules file (repo-relative or absolute) copied into every brief under a section the debrief drops; free text, then "### allow: <id>" blocks a card pulls in with allow: [<id>]. Empty = none. A tracked file is refused.
_evalCommand: What a background eval runner runs once per new origin/main sha when the session is idle; empty = no eval. Needs autoEval true here or set with /delegation config autoEval true.
_issueRepo: Unset (leave this key out): /delegation debrief post files the mod findings, one issue per finding after showing them, in the mod's own tracker, from any repo. owner/name files them there instead; "" turns posting off.
_ignore: globs a repo=here delta never counts
_delegateOnly: off | warn | deny: whether an opus or fable brain may edit source itself
